title: Identification of a Transcriptomic Prognostic Signature by Machine Learning Using a Combination of Small Cohorts of Prostate Cancer.
summary: Machine-learning integration of prostate-cancer transcriptomic cohorts produced a prognostic gene signature and evaluated survival stratification in independent datasets; biological mechanisms remain candidates.
